assumes Schooling Form when HP is above 25% max HP, or Solo Form otherwise

verified via Showdown source: two real corrections — (1) the check is strictly ABOVE 25%, so at exactly 25% HP it reverts to Solo Form, not School Form (was previously '25% or higher'); (2) the trigger is on_switch_in AND on_turn_end (checked continuously), not on_hit — School Form can revert mid-battle from any HP loss, not just from being hit by a move
